title: Arrival at the Lighthouse
body:
## Flow

The party reaches the lighthouse at nightfall.
Harbourmaster Jorna waits at the foot of the stairs — she hired the party
and wants to see results.

> [!readaloud] The tower rises black against the evening sky. No
> light burns in the lantern, and the spray beats hard against the
> rocks. Somewhere above you a door bangs in the wind — again and
> again, as if nobody had the strength left to close it.

> [!check] Wisdom (Perception) DC 13: fresh boot prints in the sand
> that do NOT come from the village but from the cove to the north.

> [!secret] The lighthouse keeper has not vanished — he is held in
> the cove so the beacon stays dark.

> [!note] If the party scouts the cove at night and gets caught
> → contingency `smuggler-captured`.
>
> | d6 | What the surf washes up |
> | --- | --- |
> | 1–2 | An empty barrel with a foreign brand |
> | 3–4 | An oar, freshly notched |
> | 5–6 | A lantern, its glass blackened with soot |
